newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's EON to sell cars on Internet.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's EON to sell cars on Internet.

text.p: Second-hand car salesmen may be known for their cheap suits and smooth banter. Buying a second hand Proton in Malaysia, however, will soon become a more on-line experience.

Malaysia's Edaran Otomobil Nasional (EON), sole distributor of the national car, the Proton, launched its new Motoria service on Thursday, offering fully reconditioned, pre-owned cars with a 12-month warranty.
Starting next year, customers can use the Internet to find the sort of Proton they are looking for.
"We will be putting the inventory (of cars) on our homepage by next year," EON managing director Adzmi Abdul Wahab told reporters at the launch.

Logging onto http://www.eon-motoria.com.my will take you into the company's database of used cars for sale, he said. "Ours is a supermarket type of operation here. The customer's choice of cars will be much larger than usual."
Motoria will eventually be able to refurbish around 17,500 vehicles a year, Adzmi said.
EON is part of the DRB-Hicom group of companies which also controls national car maker Perusahaan Otomobil Nasional Bhd (Proton).
